[[EuroLeague]] | team = Panathinaikos | number = 16 | nationality = Greek | birth_date = {{birth date and age|1999|1|2}} | birth_place = [[Heraklion]], [[Crete]], Greece | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = 2016 | career_end = | years1 = 2016–present | team1 = [[Panathinaikos B.C.|Panathinaikos]] | years2 = 2019–2020 | team2 = → [[BC Nevėžis|Nevėžis Kėdainiai]] | highlights = *4× [[Greek Basket League|Greek League]] champion ([[2016–17 Greek Basket League|2017]]–[[2018–19 Greek Basket League|2019]], [[2020–21 Greek Basket League|2021]]) *4× [[Greek Basketball Cup|Greek Cup]] winner ([[2015–16 Greek Basketball Cup|2016]], [[2016–17 Greek Basketball Cup|2017]], [[2018–19 Greek Basketball Cup|2019]], [[2020–21 Greek Basketball Cup|2021]]) | medaltemplates = }} '''Georgios "George" Kalaitzakis''' ([[Greek language|Greek]]: Γιώργος Καλαϊτζάκης; born January 2, 1999) is a Greek professional [[basketball]] player for [[Panathinaikos B.C.|Panathinaikos]] of the [[Greek Basket League]] and the [[EuroLeague]]. At a height of 2.03 m (6'8") tall[https://www.paobc.gr/en/team/george-kalaitzakis George Kalaitzakis HEIGHT 2.03.] and a weight of 87 kg (192 lbs.),[https://en.lkl.lt/zaidejai/georgios-kalaitzakis GEORGIOS KALAITZAKIS Weight: 87 kg.] he can play as a [[combo guard]], and he can also operate as a [[point forward]]. He has been regarded as one of the top [[NBA draft]] prospects in Europe, in his age range. ==Professional career== After playing with the junior youth clubs of [[Aris B.C.|Aris]], Kalaitzakis began his professional career in 2016, with the Greek club [[Panathinaikos B.C.|Panathinaikos]]. With Panathinaikos, he won the [[Greek Basketball Cup|Greek Cup]] title in 2016, 2017, and 2019, and also the [[Greek Basket League|Greek League]] championship, in 2017, 2018, and 2019. On March 2018, Kalaitzakis announced his intention to declare for the [[2018 NBA draft]].[http://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/22913797/georgios-kalaitzakis-greece-declare-nba-draft Greek guard Georgios Kalaitzakis to declare for NBA draft.] He later withdrew from the draft before the draft's withdrawal deadline. On August 28, 2019, he signed with [[BC Nevėžis|Nevėžis Kėdainiai]] of the [[Lithuanian Basketball League]], on a [[loan (sports)|loan]] deal from Panathinaikos.{{Cite web|url=http://www.kknevezis.lt/prie-komandos-jungiasi-talentingieji-broliai-kalaitzakia/|title=Prie komandos jungiasi talentingieji broliai Kalaitzakiai|date=August 28, 2019|publisher=BC Nevėžis Official Website|language=Lithuanian|access-date=August 28, 2019}} In 23 games played in the Lithuanian League's [[2019–20 LKL season|2019–20 season]], he averaged 12.2 points, 4.3 rebounds, 2.3 assists, and 1.0 steals per game, in 28.7 minutes per game.[https://en.lkl.lt/zaidejai/georgios-kalaitzakis GEORGIOS KALAITZAKIS STATISTICS.] On April 2020, Kalaitzakis declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]].[https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/29024141/greek-guard-georgios-kalaitzakis-declares-nba-draft Greek guard Georgios Kalaitzakis declares for NBA draft.] On August 11, 2020, he re-signed with [[Panathinaikos B.C.|Panathinaikos]], through the end of the 2021–22 season.[https://www.euroleague.net/news/i/asiir9g6nohedqhj/panathinaikos-locks-up-talent-kalaitzakis-until-2022 Panathinaikos locks up talent Kalaitzakis until 2022.]{{cite news |title=Panathinaikos re-signs Giorgos Kalaitzakis until 2022 |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/panathinaikos-re-signs-giorgos-kalaitzakis-until-2022/ |newspaper=Sportando |accessdate=August 11, 2020 |date=August 11, 2020}} ==National team career== Kalaitzakis has been a member of the junior national teams of Greece. With Greece's junior national teams, he played at the [[2015 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]], the [[2016 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]], and the [[2017 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]]. He also played at the [[2018 FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship]], and the [[2019 FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship]], which he led in scoring, with an average of 19.7 points per game.[http://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u20/2019/playerstats PLAYERS STATISTICS.] ==Honours and awards== * 3× [[Greek Basket League|Greek League]] Champion: ([[2016–17 Greek Basket League|2017]], [[2017–18 Greek Basket League|2018]], [[2018–19 Greek Basket League|2019]]) * 4× [[Greek Basketball Cup|Greek Cup]] Winner: ([[2015–16 Greek Basketball Cup|2016]], [[2016–17 Greek Basketball Cup|2017]], [[2018–19 Greek Basketball Cup|2019]], [[2020–21 Greek Basketball Cup|2021]]) ==Personal life== Kalaitzakis' [[twin]] brother [[Panos Kalaitzakis|Panos]]{{Cite news|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/nevezis-signs-georgios-and-panagiotis-kalaitzakis/|title=Nevezis signs Georgios and Panagiotis Kalaitzakis|date=August 28, 2019|newspaper=Sportando|language=En|access-date=August 28, 2019}} is also a professional basketball player.
